name: radio-cards
title: Radio cards
description: One choice among rich options as cards with optional media, icon, detail and a figure; one selection ring follows the stable choice.
whenToUse: Choosing one of a few rich options with a description or price.
Choosing one of a few image variants or output formats while keeping every option in a stable row.
The main choice of a form (a goal, a plan) as a field with its label, help and error.

anatomy: card (m-control): optional media, head (icon tile, label, detail, radio mark = RadioGroup's m-toggle dot), figure
figure: closes a grid card under a line-soft seam (body face, tabular digits); inline-end in stacked rows
one measured selection ring (1.5px accent) that glides
keyboard: The selected card keeps its stable value and focus when the caller updates its media or labels.
spec.motion: The ring stretches toward the chosen card on both axes and gathers there: the edges on the side it travels lead and the others follow a beat later, critically damped, never overshooting. Reduced motion: it jumps.

props.name: cards
props.type: { value, label, media?, detail?, figure?, icon?, disabled? }[]

props.name: layout
props.description: Explicit layout wins the existing stacked shorthand. Row preserves source order and uses cardWidth or the inherited card-width token.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Visual parts: root, item, media, head, icon, text, label, detail, mark, figure and ring. Styling does not replace radio semantics or indicator measurement.

props.name: style
props.description: The visual root; inherited --pui-radio-cards-card-width controls responsive sizing unless cardWidth is explicit.

props.name: field / hideLabel / description / error
props.description: A form field: label above, help or error below, on whenever the label shows; hideLabel for a view switch or quick filter (the label stays the accessible name). name submits with a native form.

visualContract.refTarget: Internal group measurement; no public ref is exposed.

notes: Foundations exception (O1 §14.2 geometry): the selection ring is a 1.5px accent mark drawn inside the card edge (DESIGN: selection = tint/edge + mark); a line width, not a scale step. Corner nesting exception: the radio mark is a circle in every look and at every roundness (it is RadioGroup's own indicator, a shape with meaning), so it does not follow the card's corner; it sits inside the card padding.

usage.name: As a form field
usage.code:
<RadioCards
  label="Main goal"
  required
  value={goal}
  onValueChange={setGoal}
  description="We plan the first four weeks around it."
  error={submitted && !goal ? "Choose the goal that matters most." : undefined}
  cards={[
    { value: "fat", label: "Lose fat", detail: "Steady deficit, keep strength", icon: <Flame /> },
    { value: "muscle", label: "Build muscle", detail: "Progressive overload", icon: <Dumbbell /> },
  ]}
/>
